_doc: The case bank. TRIAGED 2026-07-28 against the rebuilt qualifying filter in knowledge/CASE_CRAFT.md. The filter added a HARD GATE that a case must have a disclosed cost class AND a disclosed decision-to-working timeline, because if we cannot tell the reader what it took, it is a story and not a plan. NONE of the 16 seeded cases carried a cost, and their 'timeline' fields held an announcement date rather than a duration, so all 16 were demoted from candidate to lead. They are not deleted: each carries a `qualification` block naming exactly which filter parts hold and exactly what a scout must go find, which is a far better starting point than an empty bank. Ship-ready count is 0, so the first run under the new contract triggers a full Phase 1 restock, which is the correct and honest state. Entries also predate the 2024-or-later recency rule and the 50-1000 employee band; both are recorded per entry.

cases.size: 700 plus trucks, 650 plus drivers, family founded 1955
cases.bottleneck: Rising insurance costs, paper heavy back office, overdue preventive maintenance, no visibility into driver risk or trailer utilization.
cases.build: Samsara AI dash cams with automated driver coaching, telematics, driver app, smart trailer dormancy reports, plus an internal Fraley Score driver performance system built on top.

numbers.what: insurance cost reduction 2020 to 2023 while the market rose about 20 percent
back office admin savings, 99 percent less paperwork processing time
fewer overdue preventive maintenance checks
total estimated annual savings across programs

cases.skepticism: Vendor case study. The insurance number is the most concrete and externally anchored line. The rest are company estimates. Label vendor sourced.
cases.alaska_translation: Alaska trucking and air cargo run the same math with harsher roads and higher stakes. Insurance, maintenance compliance, and back office paperwork are universal fleet bottlenecks.
cases.notes: Strongest single company story in the bank for relatability. Alternates surfaced but not fetched, Halvor Lines (Netradyne), Dohrn Transfer (Samsara).

cases.notes: Family produce house archetype. Pairs with the public sector plow route evidence for a boring optimization pays theme.

numbers.what: overall accuracy after fine tuning, 85 on the hardest cases

cases.notes: The model tuning capability file anchor. Over the size band as a tech firm, use for the mechanism with the size caveat said plainly.

cases.location: Fort Worth, Texas, eight offices statewide
cases.size: 375 employees per the Microsoft customer story; a MicroAge client story fetched the same day says 400. Founded 1956. Works in more than 100 Texas cities.
cases.industry: engineering and design services (civil, structural, survey, planning, permitting)
cases.bottleneck: Licensed engineers burned more than 10,000 hours a year flipping through city, county and state code manuals to check a design complied. Per the VP of Technology, 'Our most valuable people were spending their time flipping through PDFs.' A graduate engineer, on the same page: 'Our work often touches multiple manuals that are each 500 pages or more.'
cases.build: An agent named Atlas, configured on Microsoft Copilot Studio and deployed inside Teams. Subject matter experts keep an Excel manifest of 200-plus regulatory sources. A Power Automate flow scrapes those on a schedule, converts to PDF and files them in SharePoint. A second flow indexes them into Azure AI Search tagged to a city bucket. An engineer picks a city, asks a plain-language question, the flow queries the index with the city filter, pulls the top five chunks, runs them through an Azure Functions citation matcher that maps each chunk back to an exact page, then generates an answer with a confidence score, inline citations and links into a PDF viewer that highlights the paragraph. Thin answers escalate to a human subject matter expert with the whole conversation packaged.

ladder_rung.why: The retrieval core is rung 2 and the honest teaching is that the value comes from the citation rather than the generation. The shipped thing is a rung 4 workflow: scheduled ingestion, a city filter passed into a tool call against a search index, a separate function app re-checking citations, then generation, then a human escalation path. Fixed steps a human designed. Nothing plans its own route.

numbers.what: reduction in time engineers spend querying city codes, firm-wide, annual. The engineer's own phrasing is 'decreasing by 90% or more'
the size of the BEFORE burden and also quoted as the saving. The base needs pinning down before it goes on a slide. Capacity, not cash.
share of the firm's year returned, firm-wide
citation accuracy BEFORE they added the Azure Functions paragraph matcher. The most useful honest number in the story.
IT ticket reduction from a second agent, DAVE, company-wide, no period stated

cost.value: No dollar figure on any of three fetched pages (Microsoft customer story, Microsoft Learn case study, MicroAge client story). Copilot Studio list pricing is public but list price is not what this customer paid and does not satisfy the gate.

cases.timeline: Partial. A two-month intensive Power Platform and Copilot Studio course with partner MicroAge, then a prototype at a Microsoft Build-A-Thon, then iteration in production including a re-platform from Dataverse to Azure AI Search. No clean decision-to-working date pair on any fetched page.

named_human.name: Brian Bowden, PE
named_human.role: Vice President of Technology and Principal
named_human.quote: The speed to getting the answer was the end goal of creating the bot. Previously, if a client had a question in a meeting, our engineers would have to say, 'We'll look into that and get back to you.' Now, they're able to query the bot in a meeting and answer the client's question immediately.

cases.limit_named_by_source: Two, both named by the sources. Atlas is deliberately fenced to approved knowledge sources and instructed not to infer, assume or summarize beyond what is documented, and every answer must carry a citation and a source link. And coverage is partial: Atlas currently supports roughly half of Dunaway's cities.
cases.skepticism: Numbers are the company's own carried by its platform vendor. The 90 percent is the engineer's estimate rather than system-measured. The 10,000 hours appears both as the before-burden and as the after-saving. Employee count differs across two fetched pages (375 vs 400). Offsetting that, the Microsoft Learn write-up is unusually candid: it names the 70 percent citation-accuracy problem, the re-platform, and the partial coverage.
cases.alaska_translation: Engineering, architecture and permitting-heavy firms here carry the same load, plus municipal and borough code across a state where jurisdictions differ hard. ANCSA subsidiaries running federal proposal and compliance practices have the same shape of problem at larger volume.
cases.notes: THE STRONGEST LEAD IN THE BANK as of 2026-08-29. Clears six of seven filters cleanly and is a coverage-gap sector with a genuine agent-washing teaching moment.
